snippet.title: Lethal Dungeon // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3344320/Lethal_Dungeon/

Lethal Dungeon is a roguelike card game. Win every battle using only the cards in your opening hand to defeat all enemies in a single turn.

Developed by 
Nihohe Soft
